item.title: Home secretary to announce longer settlement wait for migrants
item.body: Shabana Mahmood will announce new rules on Monday under which most legal migrants are likely to wait a decade to settle in the UK, and some up to 15 years. MPs warn of health and social care staff shortages. Ministers, including the housing secretary, had raised concerns.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏛️ Home secretary to announce longer settlement wait for migrants

Shabana Mahmood will announce new rules on Monday under which most legal migrants are likely to wait a decade to settle in the UK, and some up to 15 years. MPs warn of health and social care staff shortages. Ministers, including the housing secretary, had raised concerns.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 1 November, 19:50
